name: video_cut
description: Cut a completed video creation to a time range (free, no AI). Returns a new queued video creation; the source is untouched. End time is clamped to the video duration. Chain outputs into `video_concatenate` to re-assemble.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed video creation to cut from.

endSeconds.description: Cut end, in seconds. Values past the end of the video are clamped.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

startSeconds.description: Cut start, in seconds from the beginning of the video.

visible.description: Whether the cut appears in the user's library and feed. Defaults to true. Pass false for a working intermediate you will only feed into another tool; the returned identifier stays usable as input either way.
